name: obsidian-forge
description: Obsidian vault lifecycle management — AI inbox classification, vault integrity checks (tags, links, frontmatter), graph health reporting, and multi-vault git sync.

interface.shortDescription: Obsidian vault lifecycle management — AI inbox, integrity checks, sync.
interface.longDescription: Rust CLI for Obsidian vault automation: AI-powered inbox classification (PARA routing) with duplicate detection, vault integrity checks (tag health, broken wikilinks, frontmatter normalization) with AI-assisted fix suggestion and missing-frontmatter generation, graph health reporting, multi-vault git sync, and a background daemon. Rate-limited AI requests (global throttle + exponential backoff) keep free-tier providers usable. Single binary, multi-vault, zero config to start.
